description: Code with syntax colors, monospaced font and copy of the original content.

howToUse: Use it for code people copy: install commands, examples, API keys.
Set `language` for the colors and `label` for the file name or the purpose ("Production API key").
Use `secret` for keys: the value stays hidden, shows only the last characters, and the copy button copies the full value.
alternatives: A word of code inside a sentence: `<code>`.

keyboard.action: Moves to the copy button and, with `secret`, to the show button.
Copies the code, or shows and hides the secret.

props.name: code
props.description: Actual block content: what the copy button puts on the clipboard.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom rendering (e.g. highlight). Ignored while `secret` is masked.

props.name: language
props.description: Language for automatic highlighting: tsx, ts, js, json, css, html, bash. Unknown uses plain text.

props.name: secret
props.description: Masks the content (API keys) with a reveal toggle. Copy copies the real value.

props.name: visibleChars
props.description: Number of trailing characters visible in `secret` mode.

props.name: revealLabel
props.description: aria-label of the toggle when masked.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: aria-label of the toggle when revealed.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally (narrow columns). Default `false`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
